title: Expose the Phoenix MCP tool surface as an agent-first CLI
outcome: Shell-capable agents can discover and invoke every Phoenix tool through the existing executable while reusing the shared daemon and receiving the unchanged structured MCP JSON contract.
acceptance: Arguments derive from live MCP input schemas and support direct scalar flags, a complete JSON object, and file or stdin JSON input without aliases.
CLI invocations connect through the existing shared-daemon election path and never start a standalone writer or fallback topology.
Product tests decisively cover discovery, schema/help, success, domain error, local and server bad_request, unavailable daemon, JSON-only stdout, and two calls sharing one daemon.
README and agent documentation describe the CLI; BuildInfo.Version and features[] expose the new capability; all repository quality and adversarial review gates pass.
The same Phoenix executable supports tools, help, schema, and exact MCP tool-name invocation without duplicating navigation business logic.
stdout contains exactly one newline-terminated JSON document; deterministic exit codes distinguish success or partial, domain error, bad input, daemon unavailable, and interruption.

completion.summary: Shipped the agent-first Phoenix CLI in commit eee9ee5 and published the win-x64 self-contained single-file executable at artifacts/win-x64/PhoenixCodeNav.Mcp.exe.
